## guide

- [Tools By AI](/en/guide/index.md): Learn the core philosophy behind Tools By AI. We focus on AI as a powerful assistant to build controllable, reliable, and custom tools, not on full AI autonomy.
- [Translation Tools](/en/guide/translation/index.md): Struggling with text translation in your projects? We offer specialized tools for JSON, Markdown, and subtitle files, supporting batch translation and multiple APIs.
- [Introduction](/en/guide/translation/json-translate/index.md): Need to translate JSON files? This tool is designed for i18n, supporting global, node-specific, and key-based translation modes to streamline localization.
- [JSON Translate Deployment](/en/guide/translation/json-translate/deploy.md): Complete deployment guide for JSON Translation Tool, including local deployment, Vercel one-click, Cloudflare Pages, and Docker image deployment.
- [Introduction](/en/guide/translation/subtitle-translator/index.md): Need a fast, free subtitle translator? This tool batch translates SRT, ASS, VTT files in seconds with context-aware AI, multi-language support, and more.
- [Subtitle Translator Deployment](/en/guide/translation/subtitle-translator/deploy.md): Complete deployment guide for Subtitle Translator, including local deployment, Vercel one-click, Cloudflare Pages, and Docker image deployment.
- [Introduction](/en/guide/translation/md-translator/index.md): Tired of broken formatting when translating Markdown? This tool is designed for technical docs, preserving original structure while translating with multiple AI engines.
- [MD Translator Deployment](/en/guide/translation/md-translator/deploy.md): Complete deployment guide for Markdown Translator, including local deployment, Vercel one-click, Cloudflare Pages, and Docker image deployment.
- [Feature Description](/en/guide/translation/info.md): Explore the core capabilities of the translation tool. IndexedDB-based massive caching, smart concurrency control, and context optimization for long texts.
- [Translation API Guide](/en/guide/translation/api.md): How to choose the best translation service? This page compares APIs like DeepL, Google, and Azure, plus various LLMs, detailing their free tiers and ideal use cases.
- [FAQ](/en/guide/translation/faq.md): Translation empty or slow? Is my API key safe? This page answers common questions about our translation tools, covering API keys, DeepL, and data security.
- [Changelog](/en/guide/translation/changelog.md): See the complete update history for our translation tools. This page logs all new features, optimizations, and bug fixes, including major milestones like AI context translation.
- [Text Splitter](/en/guide/tools/text-splitter.md): Need to process long text? Our Text Splitter intelligently splits text by character count, custom delimiters, or paragraphs for AI input, with batch export.
- [JSON Data Matching Tool](/en/guide/json/json-match-update.md): Need to update one dataset from another? This tool matches IDs between two JSON files to accurately update values in a target field, simplifying data integration.
- [JSON Node Edit Tool](/en/guide/json/json-node-edit.md): Need to bulk edit JSON nodes? This tool finds nodes via JSONPath and lets you add prefixes, find/replace text, or directly replace values to simplify data processing.
- [JSON Node Insertion](/en/guide/json/json-node-inserter.md): Need to add new fields to a JSON file in bulk? This tool lets you precisely insert one or more new nodes after a specified target, simplifying data restructuring.
- [JSON Sort & Classify](/en/guide/json/json-sort-classify.md): Need to organize messy JSON data? This tool lets you sort and classify JSON by a specific field or custom order, with support for multi-level grouping and JSONPath.
- [JSON Value Extractor](/en/guide/json/json-value-extractor.md): Need to pull specific data from complex JSON? Use this tool to easily extract values from one or more nodes using JSONPath expressions, with optional prefixes.
- [JSON Key-Value Swap](/en/guide/json/json-value-swapper.md): Need to swap the values of two keys in a JSON array? This tool helps you do it in one click, automatically detecting all available keys to speed up data processing.
- [JSON Key-Value Mapping Tool](/en/guide/json/json-value-transformer.md): Need to migrate data between JSON structures? This tool uses JSONPath to map keys, copying values from a source to a target, ideal for multilingual content.
- [](/en/guide/translation/deploy.md)
- [管理词汇表](/en/guide/translation/glossaries.md): 将某些固定文本翻译成统一的英文版本，创建一个字典，将固定文本映射为对应的英文版本。 注意：词汇表为 NEXT 功能，以下仅为设计思路，参考：https://developers.deepl.com/docs/api-reference/glossaries 初步设计：只有完全符合的文本才会按指定内容翻译，无视翻译规则。如果是想将指定文本进行翻译，就需要将指定词汇再进行切割？ key 结构为 源条目_targetlanguage_目标条目，词汇表保存为本地文件，之后翻译自动从中读取。也就是用 t*glossarieskey 来查找，找不到才进行翻译。完整的结构为 t*${SparkMD5.hash(text)}_${targetLanguage}_${sourceLanguage}_${translationMethod}_${llmConfigHash}。
- [](/en/guide/translation/interface.md): Looking for how to configure the translation tools? This page navigates you to detailed interface instructions and Translation API settings to help you get started quickly.
- [](/en/guide/translation/md-translator/next.md): Curious about the motivation behind MD Translator? This page compares it with tools like GT4T and explains our solution. Also includes instructions for directory translation.
- [Language Support](/en/guide/translation/supported-languages.md): Complete language code reference table with 77 supported languages. Includes language codes, native names, English names, and Chinese names for batch multi-language configuration.
